notes.title: Update on visuals!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092142/83db1c7f51ecfbe897ce27094f1557ed379ccfa6.png[/img]

Tiny clouds on the ground now fly out from under the feet of Ursula at each step.
This kind of marking the steps is created to help with orientation in space of Khortlaht. Let us know what could also bring some good effect to the world. 
[previewyoutube=X4i_fQaxKrk;full][/previewyoutube]
